title: Nonprofit
description: A mission-driven nonprofit site in a severe annual-report register: monumental impact-numbers typography, program spreads, a volunteer calendar that splits upcoming from past by itself with a computed next-day badge, a volunteer signup form, and a Donate CTA that links out to the org's own donation page — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: The monolith register's brand overlay: monolith carries no accent hue at all — its accents ARE the ink (near-black in light mode, white in dark), and the Donate CTA reads as a hard white plate on true black. Setting brand to those same inks re-brands app surfaces into the register without shifting the marketing pages. Mode is dark: monolith's native mode.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). Declares what a composer (agent or tool) must bind for a generated variant of this pack to present as real: slot paths into the typed content module, their kinds, and minimums. events feeds the computed volunteer calendar (upcoming/past split, next-day badge) — its start slots are ISO local datetimes a composer must bind exactly, never prose. stats values are strings on purpose (units and shapes like "92%" or "$0.86" are typography, not arithmetic). Authored alongside the module and guarded by the pack's content tests — the module satisfies the contract; the contract never drifts ahead of it.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed, merged over repobot.content.json at compose (the same overlay path as landing/theme — scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs applyPackOverlays). The events domain mirrors content.ts events entry for entry (the seed-fidelity tests pin it), minus the photographs — imagery stays code-owned and the pack joins it back by slug (View/Nonprofit/calendar.ts). Upcoming vs. past and the "Next up" highlight stay computed at render time by the events engine wherever the facts come from.

entries.title: Earth Day cleanup, all crews
entries.description: Our biggest day of the year: eleven hundred volunteers, six tons of debris out of the water, and the season's first crawdad sighting.

entries.title: Science Saturday: summer sampling
entries.location: Meet at the field lab, Georgetown
entries.description: Monthly water-quality round with the summer index samples — the readings the state delisting reviews lean on hardest.

entries.title: Rain garden blitz week
entries.description: Five days, twelve gardens, one very sore corps. Delridge's runoff now has twelve fewer straight shots at Longfellow Creek.

entries.title: Coastal cleanup day
entries.description: We take the watershed's finish line: two miles of shoreline where everything the creeks carry ends up. Gloves, grabbers, and coffee provided.

entries.title: Fall planting kickoff
entries.description: First dig of the planting season: four thousand willow stakes and sedge plugs into the reach the summer crews prepped. No experience needed — the mud teaches fast.

entries.title: Rain garden build day
entries.description: Last builds before the ground gets stubborn. Three yards, three basins, and the corps' famous chili at noon.

entries.title: Volunteer appreciation night
entries.description: The year's numbers on the big screen, the blooper reel from the trail cameras, and the golden wader award. Plus-ones welcome.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/Nonprofit/NonprofitPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match nonprofitLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is monolith (true black, strict ink-and-paper, monumental scale-1.3 display, the beam, zero accent hue) — the annual-report register: photography is the only color, numbers do the persuading, and the Donate plate is the whole accent budget.
